spec_match.rationale: Exercises the privateToken RequestInit member's construction-time grammar — operation enum, version, issuers — by really constructing Requests and sweeping valid and invalid values, exactly the surface the feature standardises.

interactive.rationale: Operation/version/issuer controls build a live request with a verdict, and the sweep button runs a 14-value validity matrix; verified 6/14 accepted with the browser's own chained TypeErrors quoted per rejection.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises measuring the whole grammar from a page with no issuer or token, which the construction-time approach delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Bogus and empty enum values, bad versions and malformed issuers are all in the sweep, and the accepted-means-shape-only caveat is stated explicitly.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6210457816924160 and Private State Tokens material.

conformance.rationale: The suite's operation-vocabulary and request-carrier assertions mirror this page's sweep; on Chromium 141 the route ran 6 pass / 0 fail — the API is genuinely present.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): default construction accepted, sweep produced 6/14 accepted with real enum-rejection TypeErrors surfaced verbatim; console clean, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs each construction verdict and the sweep tally.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, verdict and matrix use token colours with text verdicts, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled controls, captioned matrix with scoped headers, aria-live verdict and detail.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); long error strings wrap.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/private-verification-tokens/the-request-option/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp), where the privateToken request option genuinely exists. The construction-time validation demo works end to end: the builder accepted a well-formed request, the sweep validated 14 grammar cases (6 accepted) and surfaced Chrome's chained property-path TypeErrors verbatim, and the copy correctly bounds what acceptance proves. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 6 pass / 0 fail. Clears the bar with no follow-ups.
